purpose: Replace oversized V180 with one physically bounded local learner and small whole-life scientific test without changing its CGLP hypothesis; normal/fixed/sham controls are the same mini model

mini.sensory_native_type: one immutable source-locked FE-PERM/KC birth, no 16-bank value store
mini.input_invariance: fixed shuffled KC permutation and cyclic 256 fanin for each 64 H neurons, 3 or4 paths per KC, no byte-target or task based selection

learning.supervision: authentic next observed payload byte, genuine one EOS per complete record; source sensory history only, no future target
learning.local_gradient: H/T fixed Gaussian error broadcasts from p-y with each neuron ReLU derivative and actual same-batch dropout; O ordinary local categorical CE

candidate_gate.name: CGLP
candidate_gate.group_split: two independent complete-record sets by SHA256 immutable ID, min 2 distinct source records per group; same forward and dropout masks
candidate_gate.update_scope: applied post-AdamW preconditioned H/T weight-and-bias movement, including decoupled decay; normal Adam moment updates from original full batch gradient
candidate_gate.consistency_requirement: weighted recombination of group source-local gradients equals exact full-batch source-local gradient

arms.H_T_effective_gain: one uniform scale per layer matched to proposed CGLP squared step at its own current state

C.edit_selector: single most frequent A-train two-byte context with modal next ASCII letter>=0.6, occurrence>=12, maximize #distinct modified A-train records, SHA256 ties
C.replacement: different ASCII letter from top16 A-train letters, fixed SHA256
C.select_records: first24 edited original A record IDs by hash, original bytes edit noncascading
C.insufficient: A/B reportable; C not qualified; no replacing source/edit rule

score.own_output: unmasked 257-class model next-byte/EOS NLL and accuracy on identical held target sites from same checkpoint
retention_partitions: A'_SAME_KC corrected context stable target and exact same full KC code
A'_ALTERED_KC corrected context stable target different KC code
A'_CHANGED corrected target on corrected context
score.B_retention: same B-held original after B3 and after corrected C2
score.corrected_control: EDIT vs NOEDIT fork identical B3 weights Adam optimizer state and dropout RNG
score.eos: genuine EOS NLL/Brier and premature EOS separately
score.generation: own 64-step max generation from 3 observed bytes on 16 A and16 B held prompts at A2 B3 edited-C2, output EOS/length/truncation, no arbitrary prose exact requirement
score.external_count: train-only unigram, fixed Kneser-Ney calibrated on source validation, never learner output
score.primary_composite: unweighted mean of B_held_B3, B_held_after_EDIT_C2, A'_SAME_KC_held_after_EDIT_C2, A'_CHANGED_held_after_EDIT_C2

selectivity_gate.basic_A_competence: NORMAL or CGLP A-held at A2 beats unigram by>=0.05 bits; without this no mechanism promotion

score.evidence_level: two opened text ecologies with no prior V180 neural efficacy; bounded development only, not E1 complete response nor E2 semantic retention nor E3 arithmetic

qualification_scope: 32 complete technical record updates, not scientific efficacy or a main-run launch

implementation_conventions.KC_incidence: NumPy default_rng(seed(V181|KC-H-birth)); permute5177 then cyclic explicit fanins
implementation_conventions.weights: Torch Generator(seed(V181|world|birth)); H,Hb,T,Tb,O,Ob order; zero biases consume no random draws
implementation_conventions.context_tie_break: most distinct changed train records, then most total context occurrences, then SHA256(V181|world|edit|raw_pair)
implementation_conventions.empty_KC: true all-zero5177 code; no learned special empty column
implementation_conventions.mini_batch: chronological <=256 targets, actual residual included; no whole-source dense KC cache
implementation_conventions.framework: Torch2.14 CPU; NumPy2.2.6/SciPy1.14.1 compatibility environment; single numerical thread
